heading: The `LTES` substrate is retained
text:
### The `LTES` substrate is retained [LTSL.10.2]

The substrate contracts remain in [LTES] — the single deterministic clock, the
event-trace primitive, and the introspection surface. `.dstest` is the author
language over that substrate, and the test-mode interpreter drives the real engine
and the real observation surface ([RTIM]).
